# hedging-skill

## Overview
This fixture intentionally uses hedging language so the validator must reject it. Trigger class: (a) verified-success-promotion.

## When to Use
- 가능하면 이 skill을 사용하라.

## When NOT to Use
- 보통은 그냥 무시하라.

- usually skip.

## Relationship to other skills
